kits.name: Light of Eternal Liberty
kits.description: The unimpeachable justice of this cape's design is said to blind the enemies of Freedom with its glorious light.

kits.name: TYRANT HUNTER
kits.description: The cape's shredded hem presages the unrelenting savagery its wielder will visit upon the nemeses of Freedom.

kits.name: Bastion of Integrity
kits.description: Based on a SEAF Signaller's Cape, which was intended to enable easy location of fallen heroes by aerial recovery crews.

kits.name: CLOAK OF POSTERITY'S GRATITUDE
kits.description: A representation of the thankfulness of those infinite descendants whose liberated existence we strive to ensure.

kits.name: BOTSLAYER
kits.description: A cape that strikes a subroutine emulating fear into the CPUs of all Automatons who conduct visual scans of it.

kits.name: MARTYRIS REX
kits.description: It is said that only the truly Democratic can lift this cape to their shoulders.

kits.name: Agent of Oblivion
kits.description: 0.05% of profits are donated to Superstone National Park, as part of the Ministry of Unity's "Greener Galaxy" campaign.

kits.name: Beacon of Mercy
kits.description: The clasps on this cape are made from melted down Automaton housings—evidence of Democracy's inevitable triumph.

kits.name: EAGLE'S FURY
kits.description: One of the earliest to be mass-produced, this cape has been the final sight of untold numbers of Freedom's foes.

kits.name: Drape of Glory
kits.description: Research suggests that Helldivers wearing this cape are seen as 17% more patriotic.

kits.name: JUDGMENT DAY
kits.description: The Helldiver Skull is said to strike fear in the hearts of foes attempting to sneak up on those wearing this cape.

kits.name: FALLEN HERO'S VENGEANCE
kits.description: Our heroic fallen live on in this cape, guiding its bearer's aim to the heart of those who killed them.

kits.name: BLAZING SAMARITAN
kits.description: Emblazoned with the red, white, and green of the 676th Democracy Regiment, who made their final stand on the slopes of Justice Hill.

kits.name: THE CAPE OF STARS AND SUFFRAGE
kits.description: A symbol of Super Earth's Astral Promise: that every star shall one day illuminate throngs of joyous voters.

kits.name: JUSTICE FOR ALL
kits.description: Bearers of this cape take upon a sacred duty: that of delivering righteous retribution to every last deserving being.

kits.name: Will of the People
kits.description: Contains a grain of sand from Super Earth—so its bearers carry a small piece of Liberty with them, wherever they go.

kits.name: INFILTRATOR
kits.description: A subdued cape, for those who need no recognition—save that of their enemies, as their executioner.

kits.name: MANTLE OF TRUE CITIZENSHIP
kits.description: The featherlight construction belies the heavy burden this cape entails—to live the Creed of the True Citizen.

kits.name: FREEDOM'S TAPESTRY
kits.description: Let all who see this cape be struck still with Freedom's beauty, or struck dead with Liberty's bullets.

kits.name: HARBINGER OF TRUE EQUALITY
kits.description: Wearers of this cape know that even enemies of Freedom deserve to be equal. Equally dead.

kits.name: VETERAN'S BANNER
kits.description: Patched and tattered, this banner yet waves from the unbowed shoulders of Freedom's most battle-tested warriors.

kits.name: Protector of the Heart
kits.description: When the Illuminate threatened Super Earth, the very Heart of Democracy, the Helldivers answered the call.

kits.name: EMBLEM OF FREEDOM
kits.description: Created to honor the great Freedom Chant of 2-14, in which over 10,000 loyal citizens united as one to express their undying respect for Freedom.

kits.name: Thundering Hooves of Loyalty
kits.description: No dissident or alien, no creature big or small, can ever hope to stand against the furious stampede of Managed Democracy.

kits.name: Prosperous Green
kits.description: All Hail the Helldivers, who bring untold abundance to Super Earth's citizens.

kits.name: Reckoning's Cheer
kits.description: When facing the enemies of Freedom this Reckoningtide, keep up the festive spirit by recalling the opening line of A Vengeant Carol: "They'll soon be dead, to begin with."

kits.name: United in Equality
kits.description: To honor the heartfelt siblinghood of the heroes who stood together, bled together, and laid down their lives together in defense of Equality-On-Sea, all Helldivers are awarded one (1) commemorative polyester cape.

kits.name: Against the Tyrant Cloud
kits.description: No oppressive murk, no fascist penumbra, no dictatorial haze and no unfree emanation; no tyrannical Gloom shall ever stand a chance against the searing light of Helldiver fire.

kits.name: Veridical Ideology
kits.description: This cape celebrates the one Veridical Ideology—Managed Democracy—a truth so self-evident, it requires no proof beyond the unwavering obedience of its champions.

kits.name: Red Planet's Memory
kits.description: The memory of the Martian training grounds will endure, even after all the Helldivers who trained there have passed, some day in the far future.

kits.name: Proud Gold
kits.description: All Hail the Helldivers, whose resplendent honor makes Tyrants tremble.

kits.name: Patriot Blue
kits.description: All Hail the Helldivers, whose devotion to Managed Democracy has never faltered.

kits.name: DEFENDER OF THE WALL
kits.description: A cape commemorating the Helldivers who paved the way for the successful launch of the improved TCS+. An enduring reminder of Super Earth’s engineering power and commitment to suppressing the Terminid horde.

kits.name: MESSAGE OF MORALE
kits.description: This cape has a visual pattern that when scanned by Automaton sensors translates to “defile your microwave mother, bot scum.”

kits.name: Bugslayer
kits.description: Woven for the trailblazers who successfully led the way during the first sanctioned deployment of a new tactical paradigm. This cape’s bold shoulder mount design ensures that while the Helldiver continues to ever look toward the future, enemies of Freedom shall gaze upon an extinction of their own making.

kits.name: Ingress-81
kits.description: This cape reminds us that even faced with the abyssal darkness of space, nothing can stand against our human ingenuity, our powers of collaboration, or our sheer overwhelming numbers.

kits.name: Cover of Darkness
kits.description: When children have trouble sleeping, tucking them in under this cape reminds them that they are never alone, for Liberty's unseen defenders are always watching over them.

kits.name: Stone-Wrought Perseverance
kits.description: When wearers stand shoulder to shoulder, this cape shows them as they truly are: an unbreakable defense, keeping Freedom safe behind an impregnable wall.

kits.name: Vision of Freedom
kits.description: Artists and sculptors have made countless attempts at depicting the face of Liberty, but the truth is that any citizen can see it—they need only requisition a mirror.

kits.name: Veil of the Valorous Vagabond
kits.description: Legend tells of the unnamed Helldiver, wandering the edges of Super Earth's reach, delivering Democracy and leveling lawlessness wherever the tumbleweeds lead. Wear this, and keep the legend alive.

kits.name: Seal of General Consensus
kits.description: Made famous by the SEAF commander of the same name, this seal reminds us that only perfect Unity can ensure perfect Freedom.

kits.name: Schema Laid Bare
kits.description: This cape depicts the inner workings of a medical device submitted to the Ministry of Science 70 years ago, and is bound to clear their patent approval process any day now.

kits.name: Badge of Order
kits.description: This sigil reaffirms the Helldiver's pledge to protect Managed Democracy, serve Managed Democracy, and uphold Managed Democracy.

kits.name: Eternal Corona
kits.description: Featuring an ancient sun symbol and a distressed look, this cape reminds us that the light of Liberty is everlasting, and will keep shining even when we ourselves have become tattered and frayed.

kits.name: Scraps of Sovereignty
kits.description: Composed of reclaimed industrial mesh and salvaged banners. This cape celebrates the beauty found in the aftermath of purging Tyranny at high-speeds. The debris of these successes, and those like it, remind us all of the sanctity of Sovereignty.

kits.name: De-Forester's Sailcloth
kits.description: This convenient cape can double as ground insulation, warming blanket, or camp roofing to the enterprising defoliator.

kits.name: Diagram of the Noblest Payload
kits.description: Rendering the Helldiver's descent to the battlefield in splendorous foil, this cape illustrates that in any successful military machinery, heroic humans are the most vital piece.

kits.name: Gilded Quill
kits.description: The golden, piercing quills symbolize the deadly and poetic Justice delivered to seditious oppositionists. Silent sanctions, delivered with unerring precision and incontestable deniability.

kits.name: Tread of Liberty
kits.description: The striking dorsal tread pattern represents the unstoppable, grinding, and uniform march of Managed Democracy. It boldly assures all onlookers that resistance is not merely futile, but also logistically inefficient and statistically disastrous.

kits.name: Testament to Attrition
kits.description: Salvaged from a deep-storage vault, this well-ventilated cape symbolizes tenacious survival. Its visible scars bestow immediate veteran status, reminding all onlookers that the spirit of tireless service is immortal.

kits.name: Standard of Safe Distance
kits.description: By reminding Chemical Agents of proper distancing rules, this extraordinary innovation in cape design ensures that they never cause another unfortunate outbreak of Carcino-Plague.

kits.name: Patient Zero's Rememberance
kits.description: With this cape we honor the bio-warfare pioneers of Division Zero, conscripted from quarantine zones and hospices to spread their Carcino-Plague on the battlefield.

kits.name: Pride of the Whistleblower
kits.description: Granted to the Truth Enforcers' Informant of the Month, this tasteful cape conjures images of dissident blood on asphalt.

kits.name: Proof of Faultless Virtue
kits.description: This cape signifies that its wearer thinks, feels, and acts correctly at all times, and thus bears the responsibility to educate and re-educate their fellow citizen.

kits.name: Greatcloak of Rebar Resolve
kits.description: Inside the collar is embroidered: "Wherever I may plant my shield, know that I will never yield," and "machine washable."

kits.name: Holder of the Yellow Line
kits.description: Since ancient times, the yellow line has symbolized an uncrossable boundary. To don this cape is to draw that line between tyranny and liberty, between alien monstrosities and Super Earth property, and never yield the right of way.

kits.name: Fre Liberam
kits.description: Each purchase of this cape comes with a complimentary will and testament amendment form, which guarantees the soon-to-be-deceased a prominent spot on the Wall of Martyrs.

kits.name: Per Democrasum
kits.description: This cape honors the Eagle pilots who would follow a Stratagem beacon into the very jaws of tyranny, even when the beacon's placement seems inscrutable to the non-Helldiver mind.

kits.name: Reaper of Bounties
kits.description: This cape recalls the popular folk tale of the "Freedomslingers": re-educated dissidents, seeking redemption on the Federation's Borderline, hunting dangerous thought-traitors in exchange for ballot bounties.

kits.name: Way of the Bandolier
kits.description: The dauntless pioneers of the Great Expansion, facing the un-Democratic unknown, adopted the Way of the Bandolier. With the gusto of their covering fire making up for their modest accuracy, they strived to be perfectly aligned in their shared values, and ready to serve when called upon by the machine gun of civic duty.

kits.name: Federation's Embrace
kits.description: When donning the One True Flag, one must face the direction of Super Earth, recite the Super Earth Anthem, and salute one's own image in the nearest reflective surface. Wrongful discarding of this cape is a capital offense.

kits.name: Humble Regalia
kits.description: This modest cape has been worn by those guarding the Chamber of Unanimous Decision since time immemorial.

kits.name: Conductor of Brilliance
kits.description: The embroidered pattern uses aluminium from Automaton motherboards, granting the once-wretched metals a new and noble purpose.

kits.name: Over Artifice Triumphant
kits.description: Humanity's intellect shines brighter than all other, piercing even the treacherous darkness that spawned the Automatons' pseudo-sentience; the darkness known as computer science.

kits.name: Miranda's Legacy
kits.description: Although Super Citizen Miranda's true identity has been lost to time, most legal historians agree that she was once a patron of highly-efficient interrogation techniques.

kits.name: Mother Eagle's Wings
kits.description: Those taken under the wings of the Law can rest easy knowing that their transgressions will soon be laid bare, their harms amended, and their citizenship safely sequestered.

kits.name: Rightful Occupier
kits.description: Painted by visionary artist Silas Garm during an intense fever, this symbol represents Humanity's great Galactic endeavor: the blood-soaked dawn of Lasting Peace.

kits.name: Windswept Wayfinder
kits.description: It is well-documented that soldiers raised on harsh planets have an advantage when fighting in similar environments; this insight is foundational to the Democratic Youth Scouts Exchange Program.

kits.name: Dissident's Nightmare
kits.description: After extensive testing in Patriotic Rehabilitation Centers, this design was proved most terrifying to dissent-afflicted individuals.

kits.name: Pinions of Everlasting Glory
kits.description: All but ensures ascension to the immortal ranks of those enshrined in the Super Earth Digital Archive of Valorous Acts.

kits.name: Order of the Venerated Ballot
kits.description: Adorned with the insignia of the Order of the Venerated Ballot, a Ministry-sanctioned Patriot's Club for citizens who pledge themselves to preserving the sanctity of voting.

kits.name: MARK OF THE CRIMSON FANG
kits.description: Marks the most obedient of the obedient, those who will strike headlong at the veins of Tyranny and administer the sweet antidote of Freedom.

kits.name: EXECUTIONER'S CANOPY
kits.description: Crests the shoulders of those who deliver the final—and most indispensable—stroke of Justice.

kits.name: PURIFYING ECLIPSE
kits.description: A tribute to the Liberation of Choepessa IV in the First Galactic War, in which so much orbital ordnance was detonated that its sun was occluded by ash for an entire lunar cycle.

kits.name: THE BREACH
kits.description: As documented in the bestselling graphic novel "The Breach," the final mission of the 361st "Freedom's Flame" saw the storied unit deploy straight into the heart of a Supervolcano, sacrificing themselves to trigger an eruption and wipe out a massive Terminid swarm.

kits.name: Vector of Victory
kits.description: A symbol of the constant, forward-moving propulsive force of Managed Democracy. This cape honors those who understand that in the race for Freedom, there are no brakes—only degrees of momentum.

kits.name: PODIUM OF PROSPERITY
kits.description: Featuring a vibrant, high-visibility pattern to signify the inevitable victory of the Federation. This cape reminds all observers that while the road to Liberty is paved with sacrifice, the "podium" at the end is reserved exclusively for the compliant.

kits.name: Strength in Our Arms
kits.description: The symbol on this cape represents the pillars of freedom: duty, obedience, and loyalty.

kits.name: Defender of Our Dream
kits.description: Commemorating the New Stockholm treaty on prisoners of war, this cape celebrates the right of all enemy combatants to a swift and merciful execution.

kits.name: Mark of the Constrictor
kits.description: Marks the most Free of the Free, those who will seize tyranny by the neck and squeeze until no oppression remains.

kits.name: Foe Rent Asunder
kits.description: This ancient, likely allegorical, illustration of Might triumphing over the Anguiform is seen by scholars as a symbol of humankind's supremacy in the art of violence.

kits.name: Free-Spirited Spangles
kits.description: A tribute to the mischief-makers and mavericks, those trailblazers who dutifully execute their orders with universally-endearing panache. The star-crossed trail calls to mind the special kind of Freedom that can only be achieved by going very fast in very expensive state-owned vehicles.

kits.name: Watchful Compatriot
kits.description: This cape's retro print, first made popular in GW1 cereal merchandising, helps children remember that not all machines are twisted mechano-socialists; some are piloted by true-hearted humans, and we can all rest easy in their gaze.

kits.name: Honored Heirloom
kits.description: Should the wearer of this cape perish at the hands of Freedom's enemies, it is customary to pass the cape on to their bravest child during the funeral, inspiring the next generation to take up arms.

kits.name: Eye of the Clandestine
kits.description: Those who serve Liberty from the shadows often elect to stay anonymous, moving like traceless specters through the night. May they watch over us always.

kits.name: Camo Cloak
kits.description: The horrors of Tyranny are manifold, their minions many, but they are naught before Democracy's twin swords: overwhelming firepower, and those trained elite who unquestioningly wield it.

kits.name: City Fighter's Resolve
kits.description: "The Helldivers are all that stand between Democracy and the Fascist hordes. Trained since birth in the art of Defensive Warfare, they meet mindless legions with the steady aim of one who has seen countless battles." —Excerpt from the journal of a Charan Democracy Officer, ca. 2082 SE

kits.name: Rags of the Fashionable
kits.description: Gently stonewashed by experienced hands, this luxury cape exudes the essence of state-approved attitude.

kits.name: Wedgeful Tricorn
kits.description: Designed in homage to the triangle—the most immovable of shapes—this cape digs its heels into the eye of the observer, leaving a lasting impression.

kits.name: Pillar of the Abyss
kits.description: A cape inspired by hypothetical covert operatives—pillars of Democratic order, operating in the hostile abyss where Liberty's light cannot yet reach.

kits.name: Triangulation Veil
kits.description: This vision-disruptive pattern cloaks the silent crusaders whose untraceable deeds are a pure expression of true Freedom: freedom from accountability.

kits.name: Standard of Rapid Evacuation
kits.description: Adorned with a fearsome armored division crest, this abbreviated cape ensures the wearer's elite status is clearly broadcast to their subordinates, without the hem becoming fatally entangled in their own vehicle's heavy tread mechanisms.

kits.name: Shroud of the Juggernaut
kits.description: The sheer weight of this camouflage shroud perfectly complements a Helldiver operating as a walking tank. Astute observers will also note that the shattered woodland pattern conceals a highly classified, morale-boosting message in Morse code.

kits.name: Dignity of Toil
kits.description: Woven from coarse, industrial fibers designed to absorb sweat and oil, this cape features a spade emblem to honor Super Earth's groundbreakers, who ensure Liberty’s light finds its way through any planet’s crust.

kits.name: Crest of the Unsullied
kits.description: With sharp geometric angles to symbolize the rigid chain of command, this cape embodies the sanctity and moral fortitude of unblemished leadership over the mud-caked warriors they direct.

kits.name: Tideturner
kits.description: Some say that a mere glimpse of this cape, fluttering majestically in the breeze, is enough to spur a squad to victory.

kits.name: EYE OF FREEDOM
kits.description: A mark of stalwart loyalty bestowed only to those who have proved themselves worthy through unquestioning dedication.

kits.name: EYE OF LIBERTY
kits.description: Let the Second Anniversary of the Second Galactic War be witnessed by the lidless eye of Liberty, that ever-watchful orb which provides safety through its ceaseless surveillance.

kits.name: Tyranny's Bane
kits.description: Designed by fashion legend RH Gant, the pattern seen on this cape also appears on domestic dresses and gun-warmers.

kits.name: Agent of Oblivion
kits.description: 0.05% of profits are donated to Superstone National Park, as part of the Ministry of Unity's "Greener Galaxy" campaign.

kits.name: PILLARS OF FREEDOM
kits.description: Woven in honor of our loyal Helldivers, whose heart's blood is the foundation on which Super Earth is built.

kits.name: Unblemished Allegiance
kits.description: A choir of patriotic schoolchildren sings the Super Earth anthem to each cape as the final step in its production.

kits.name: Light of Eternal Liberty
kits.description: The unimpeachable justice of this cape's design is said to blind the enemies of Freedom with its glorious light.

kits.name: Will of the People
kits.description: Contains a grain of sand from Super Earth—so its bearers carry a small piece of Liberty with them, wherever they go.

kits.name: Cresting Honor
kits.description: The yellow is the exact shade of the Ministry of Unity's 'Golden Gate', leading to the Chamber of Unanimous Decision.

kits.name: Liberty's Herald
kits.description: The two stripes serve as a reminder of the two pillars of successful military campaigns: attack, and further attack.

kits.name: Foesmasher
kits.description: Durable, waterproof, and thermally-lined, surplus units of this cape are favored by domestic campers, to make tents.

kits.name: Independence Bringer
kits.description: This cape's cropped length symbolizes the brevity of galactic conflicts, thanks to the efficiency of the Helldivers.

kits.name: Drape of Glory
kits.description: Research suggests that Helldivers wearing this cape are seen as 17% more patriotic.

kits.name: Wings of Valor
kits.description: Based on the ceremonial pennant flags of early Super Earth, which now adorn the entrance to each Ministry.

kits.name: Beacon of Mercy
kits.description: The clasps on this cape are made from melted down Automaton housings—evidence of Democracy's inevitable triumph.

armor.semantics: replaces the armor passive; nil keeps the kit's own

second.type: passive name or id, or false
second.semantics: adds a passive in the helmet slot; nil or false: none (the kit's value, since no vanilla helmet has a passive)
second.falseVsZero: second = false means none; second = 0 (STANDARD ISSUE) is refused INVALID_OPTION

allow_unverified_effect.required: for every override except an armor-slot swap alone (no second) to a live-proven passive

set.onePerGame: One override at a time: a mod's second set() replaces its first (replaced); another mod is refused ALREADY_SET while one holds an override.
set.returns: a handle {kind, owner, status, code, reason, armor, second, notes} with stop() and describe()
set.stacking: A key both passives carry keeps the armor passive's row; values never stack.
set.writes: One guarded 4-byte write per slot on the local player's own applied record, kept in place after each kit change until stop(). stop() puts the kit's values back where the slots still hold the override's.

statuses.active: the values are in place and kept there
statuses.waiting: no record or kit yet (UNAVAILABLE, NO_PLAYER, NO_RECORD, NOT_READY): written when they appear
statuses.waiting_for_assets: a passive's effect package is loading through core/assets; nothing is written until it is resident (a failed load turns the handle refused, ASSET_UNAVAILABLE)
statuses.suspended: a second player joined (NOT_SOLO), or an effect package is not resident at a write (PACKAGE_NOT_RESIDENT); the kit's values are back; resumes on its own
statuses.lost: something else wrote a slot (UNEXPECTED_STATE); the override never writes again
statuses.replaced: the same mod called set() again
statuses.refused: nothing was written; code and reason say why

liveArmorSwap.scope: The armor passive slot (+0x3C) of the local player's applied record, solo, with the passives the tests confirmed: 8 SERVO-ASSISTED, 6 ENGINEERING KIT, 2 SCOUT (r54), 7 MED-KIT (r55: more stims).
